asset.name: AutoAnimateLayout
asset.description: The declarative layout-transition component animating keyed insertion, removal, reordering, and resizing through layout-difference calculation rather than tweened layout properties.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.
Layout differences are computed within a coordination boundary.
